prompt: Write a one-star review of the Grand Canyon from a visitor who feels it was too big.
response:
I don’t understand the hype. Nobody warned me that this thing is basically an obnoxiously large hole in the ground that goes on forever. It’s honestly just too much. You pull up to the rim and your brain short-circuits because it can’t even process the scale. I wanted a nice, manageable scenic view to take a few photos for Instagram, not an existential crisis.

The sheer size is just impractical and frankly, rude. You can’t see the bottom clearly, the colors change every five minutes, and it’s so vast that it made me feel incredibly small and insignificant. I didn’t sign up for a confrontation with my own mortality; I signed up for a pretty sunset. It’s impossible to capture in a single photo, so what’s even the point? I left feeling stressed and dizzy instead of relaxed. If you’re looking for a cozy, appropriately-sized canyon, go literally anywhere else. One star.
